headline: European Gas Prices Edge Down on Amsterdam TTF Hub
summary: Benchmark Dutch TTF natural gas futures fell 0.7% to €84.77 per megawatt-hour, while Italy's GME gas price index declined to €83.99 per MWh in early European trading.
why: European natural gas pricing directly shapes heating and electricity costs for industrial consumers and power utilities across the EU.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Gas
impacts.why: TTF natural gas dropped 0.7% to €84.77/MWh on steady pipeline and storage balances.
